# FollowUpHub

> FollowUpHub is an AI-powered real estate operating system (CRM) for real estate
> agents, teams and brokerages in Canada and the United States. It contacts every
> new lead within seconds by voice AI, SMS, WhatsApp and email, then nurtures for
> up to six months, and combines that with pipeline management, marketing
> automation and client websites in a single subscription.

## Key facts

- Company: FollowUpHub, Canada
- Category: Real estate CRM / AI sales automation software
- Website: https://www.followuphub.ai
- Contact: support@followuphub.ai
- Users: 1,000+ real estate agents and 36 Canadian brokerages
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required
- Migration: contacts, pipelines and history migrated free of charge
- Commonly replaces: a separate CRM, dialer, SMS and email platform, calendar and website builder

## Pricing

- Basic, Complete Agent System: $49.99 CAD per month, or $499.90 CAD per year. Pre-built home evaluation
  funnel, conversational SMS and email AI agents, appointment reminders, visual
  pipeline management, omni-channel inbox, website and funnel builder, email
  campaigns and a social media planner.
- Advanced, Full AI Engine: $49.99 CAD per month, or $499.90 CAD per year, plus a
  one-time $299 setup fee.
  Everything in Basic plus the Voice AI engine with 6-attempt retry logic
  (10am to 9pm), 6-month Smart Nurture AI with 24 touchpoints, visual workflow
  builder, custom AI agents, Reviews AI, AI Studio and white-glove onboarding
  with A2P registration handled.
- Both plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card.
- No contract and no cancellation fee. Yearly billing gives two months free.

## Core capabilities

- Voice AI calling with natural conversation, objection handling, sentiment
  analysis and 6-attempt retry logic inside respectful calling windows
- Conversational AI across SMS, WhatsApp and email using funnel context
- Visual sales pipeline with real estate stages: new lead, contacted, showing,
  offer, closed
- Omni-channel shared team inbox with call recording and transcripts
- Marketing automation: email campaigns, social scheduling, AI post ideas
- Client websites and funnel builder, SEO-ready and mobile-first
- Reputation management, invoicing and payments, 250+ lead source integrations
